rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for physically assembling something from separate parts.

rows.note: Use this instead of the colloquial 砌 when the assembly is technical, systematic, or involves manufactured components.

example.english: Workers construct this machine by assembling the parts one by one.
example.traditional: 工人用零件逐件組裝呢部機。

example.traditional: 你要先組織好啲句子，先至講得清楚。
